Commentary.Commentary: There will be around 14 overs for the visiting side to negotiate before stumps. Stay tuned for Australia's reply...

The wicket has plenty of juice. It has pace, bounce, spin and certainly reverse swing once the ball gets old. Sri Lanka once again will be banking on their spinners to deliver the goods. Australia would like to see off today's play with minimum of casualty.

Sri Lanka will be disappointed with the total they have managed on the board after electing to bat. After losing their openers cheaply, the pair of Kusal Mendis and Kusal Perera bailed them out with a fine stand but then Australia struck back. There were a few starts for the Lankan batsmen but none of them carried on to score a big one.

Excellent bowling performance by Australia to bundle out Sri Lanka under 300. Steven Smith will be pleased with the outcome after losing the toss today. Mitchell Starc was the absolute star with the ball as he finished with a 5-wicket haul and bowled with fire and venom. The rest of the Aussie bowlers also tried hard but weren't consistent enough.

OUT! A cracking delivery by Starc, he gets it to reverse back into the left-hander at a sharp pace of 146 kph, very full and too good for Herath. He tries to dig it out but it brushes his boot before going on to destroy the stumps. Starc gets his fifth 5-wicket haul in Tests and SRI LANKA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 281!
A good yorker tailing in towards the stumps! Fernando digs it out just on time!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Herath has heaved that over mid wicket. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs. It wasn't timed sweetly!

FOUR! A fullish delivery outside off, Herath goes for the drive but gets an outside edge. The ball just manages to sneak under the gloves of the diving Neville. It fell just short of him and runs down for a boundary!
A good length delivery around off, Herath goes back and blocks it into the ground.
Mitchell Marsh is back into the attack!
Sharp delivery, short and down the leg side, 146 kph, Fernando does well to move away from the line of fire.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Debutant Vishwa Fernando is the new batsman.

OUT! Timber! Starc persists with his angle from round the wicket and serves a length ball around off at 142 kph, it straightens a touch after landing, Sandakan, who is looking to give himself room by going back, tries to put bat on ball but is beaten for pace. The stumps are disturbed and Sri Lanka lose their ninth wicket.
A cracking yorker bowled by Starc, from round the wicket and around the leg stump line, Sandakan does well to keep it out.
Full and outside off, Sandakan pushes at it and misses.
Full length ball angling down the leg side, Herath fails to flick and it goes off his pads to fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Mitchell Starc is back for another burst.
Herath tries to sweep but gets a top edge on that one. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fullish around leg, Sandakan flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Herath has swept that one through the leg side. They pick up a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Darted in around off, Herath tries to pull it but does not connect and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Presses forward to a full ball and jams it out on the off side.
Loopy off spinner around off, Sandakan gets forward and defends it on the leg side.
Slow loopy ball on middle, this time Herath plays a conventional sweep through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Fine shot! Tossed up ball on off, Herath brings out a fancy reverse sweep and nails it past the diving backward point fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up ball on off, Herath gets forward in defense but gets a little outside edge. Doesn't carry to first slip.
Tossed up ball on off, Herath reverse sweeps but finds the fielder at short third man.
Lakshan Sandakan is the new batsman.
Drinks break.

OUT! Maiden Test wicket for Holland! Full toss on off stump, de Silva gets fancy and tries to paddle it down to fine leg. He is stuck on the crease and the ball hits the pads and he is adjudged LBW! That wasn't needed at all and he gifted his wicket away to the Aussies!
Almost a carbon copy of the previous delivery.
de Silva lunges on to the front foot and blocks it into the ground.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. They manage to come back for the second.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Around middle and leg, de Silva steps down the track and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Holland into the attack!
Flighted on off, Herath defends it off his front foot. That's a wicket maiden for Lyon and also the first maiden bowled by an Australian spinner today.
Flighted outside off, pushed with an angled bat to point.
Flatter on off, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up again, outside off, Herath swings and misses after going down on one knee.
Beaten! Tossed up ball on off, spinning away, Herath tries to defend but is beaten.
Rangana Herath is the new batsman.

OUT! Given lbw! Flighted ball, Perera goes deep inside the crease to play on the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal and after thinking for a while umpire Kettleborough raises his finger. Perera takes the DRS and the replays show that it's pitching on leg and hitting the middle stump. There seems to be an inside edge too but the third umpire is quite sure there isn't anything. The onfield decision stays and Australia finally manage to break the partnership which was beginning to hurt them.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
FOUR! Similar delivery, a little wider on the off side. de Silva drives it effortlessly through the covers and gets another boundary!
FOUR! Fullish delivery outside off, de Silva leans into the drive and strikes it sweetly through the covers for a superb boundary!
de Silva shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A similar delivery, de Silva pushes it towards mid on this time.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short ball around off, banged in! It takes off the pitch! de Silva ducks under it and lets it go.
Lunges to a full ball and blocks it safely to end the over.
FOUR! Shortish and around off, spinning away, Perera goes deep inside the crease and punches it firmly through the gap at covers for a boundary.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and pushes it to mid off.
Flighted on middle, spinning away a touch, Perera defends it off his front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up ball on off, blocked off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery
Fullish around off, de Silva strikes it sweetly to the covers off his front foot.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
de Silva present the full face of the bat and defends it off his front foot.
A good length delivery around off, shaping in. de Silva tackles it well and pushes it to the covers off his back foot.
Nathan Lyon is taking some tablets near the boundary line. Not sure, what is it for...
Fullish delivery around middle, angling in, Perera works it down to fine leg for a single.
Josh Hazlewood is back into the attack!
Flighted on off, de Silva has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short around off, spinning away, it's punched off the back foot to covers where Warner makes a fine stop.
Sliding down the leg side, Perera advances down the track and flicks it aerially past square leg for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, the batsman gets forward and defends it watchfully.
Flatter ball around leg, it's punched back past the bowler to long off for a single.
FOUR! A fullish delivery outside off, Perera lunges forward confidently and drives it sweetly through the cover region for a delightful boundary!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Similar delivery, angling away. Perera again pokes at it. Poor shot selection from him!
A good length delivery outside off, shaping away, draws Perera into a shot who plays at it hesitantly and misses the ball.
A back of a length delivery around off, Perera pushes it to the covers off his back foot.
Short and wide outside off, banged in! Perera leaves it alone. Effort ball from Marsh but it needs to be well directed!
Loopy ball on off, spinning away, de Silva pads it away. The bowler appeals but it's easily missing off and hence the umpire shakes his head.
FOUR! Uppish! Tossed up ball on off, spinning away, de Silva plays an uppish square drive and luckily for him it goes through the gap between covers and point for a boundary.
Flighted and outside off, pushed to covers where Lyon dived to make a good stop. Cannot prevent the single though.
Tossed up ball on off, de Silva strokes it through mid off for a run.
Loopy ball on off, driven back to the bowler off the front foot.
Tossed up ball on middle, flicked past short leg for a run.
de Silva defends it off his back foot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Outside off, de Silva lets it go through to the keeper.
de Silva shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Dropped by Smith! Now, that's a rarity! A length ball outside off, holding its line, de Silva has a tentative poke inside the line and edges it to first slip. Smith gets both hands at it but it bursts out and hits him on the chest. The Aussie skipper tries to take it in the second attempt with a dive to his left but fails to succeed again. Nevill also attempts to take the rebound but the second attempt by Smith puts him off. A chance goes down begging and Smith will be kicking himself within. Sets high standards for himself in the field.
A back of a length delivery wide outside off, Perera works it through gully for a single.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it to end the over.

Appeal for a catch! Spin and bounce away from the batsman, from around off, de Silva gets forward in defense but is beaten. There is some sound and the keeper straightaway goes up in a huge appeal. The umpire shows no interest. The replays confirm that the noise was of the bat hitting the pad.
Quicker and fuller on off, spinning away, de Silva defends it quietly to the off side.
Floated ball on middle, de Silva gets forward and defends it watchfully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A juicy full toss first up, around middle, Perera flicks it across the line and Khawaja does well to stop it with a dive from mid-wickets. They cross for a run.
Jon Holland is back on.
Around middle and leg, Perera flicks it down to fine leg for a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, Perera pokes at it and gets beaten. Marsh is really testing Perera with his intelligent bowling!
A well directed bouncer. Perera ducks and takes evasive action.
A fullish delivery on middle, Perera strides forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A back of a length delivery outside off, Perera punches it off his back foot to the covers.
FOUR! Poor delivery, short and outside off, spinning in a touch, de Silva is quick to transfer his weight on the back foot as he smashes it through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up ball on off, Perera forces it down through mid on and takes a single.
Leg slip comes into place now.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Nearly carries! Tossed up ball on off, Perera jumps out of the crease for a big shot but ends up dragging it off the inner half of the bat. It goes on one bounce to short mid-wicket.
A touch short and on off, de Silva goes back and hits it in the gap at covers for a run.
Flighted ball on off, de Silva gets on the front foot and defends.

There is a massive inside edge! A full toss swerving into the batsman, Perera tries to keep it out but misses and is thudded on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. Perera takes a review straightaway and the replays clearly show that he got a big inside edge before the ball struck his pads. He survives!
Dilruwan Perera is given lbw. He has reviewed it immediately.
A good length delivery, angling in. Perera plays at it but misses it.
Dilruwan Perera is the new batsman.

OUT! A tad short delivery wide outside off. Mathews tries to punch it through covers but gets an outside edge and the ball carries to Nevill at a comfortable height. He pouches it safely on his right side and appeals. The umpire agrees. A loose shot by the skipper and he pays the price for it. Mathews is walking back disappointed. A good knock by him but he would have liked to bat long.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. One run added to the total.
Outside off this time, de Silva goes back and pushes it to the covers.
Fullish on off and middle, de Silva gets right behind the line of the delivery and defends it solidly.
Once again Mathews uses his feet to reach the pitch of the ball and then dead bats it down the surface.
Walks forward to the pitch of the ball and defends it back.
Gets on the front foot and defends it on the leg side.

FOUR! Not in full control but still a boundary. Tossed up ball on off, Mathews gets down on one knee and reverse sweeps it over point. It comes off the top half of the bat but still has enough to trickle past the ropes.
Around middle and spinning down, slower in pace, de Silva nudges it past short leg for a single.
Flatter on off, it's punched off the back foot to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short delivery, de Silva goes back and pulls it away to the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
25th Test fifty for Angelo Mathews, off 59 balls. Fastest for a Sri Lankan skipper against Australia.
Around off and middle, Mathews works it towards square leg for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Mathews works it towards mid-wicket.
A back of a length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A fullish delivery around off, Mathews defends it to the off side of his front foot.
Back for the last session. The players are out in the middle. 36 overs are still left in the day's play. Mitchell Marsh to begin proceedings. A slip and a gully in place...
...DAY 1, SESSION 3...

Though Sri Lanka lost three wickets in the session, they also managed to score 107 runs. Mainly due to the counterattacking knock by skipper Angelo Mathews. They are still in a good position to set up a decent score on the board. Join us in a while for the final session of the day!

It has been an exciting and happening session! The pitch is providing good support to the pace bowlers as well as the spinners. Starc and Hazlewood have extracted good reverse swing and have been rewarded for their efforts. Starc sent the well set Mendis back to the pavilion and has paved the way for Australia to come back in the match.
Flighted around leg, defended with soft hands to short fine leg. TEA ON DAY 1!
Tossed up ball on off, de Silva defends it from the crease to the leg side.
Loopy ball on off, spinning in, de Silva tries to sweep but seems to have gloved it. The ball loops in the air but falls wide of the keeper and short fine leg fielder.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shortish on middle, Mathews helps it wide of short fine leg for a single.
Tossed up ball on leg, defended on the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter and outside off, the batsman again lets it go through.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Around middle and leg, de Silva flicks it well behind square leg for a couple.
Back of a length delivery wide outside off. de Silva goes back and accross and punches it through the covers for a couple.
Length delivery around off, shaping in. de Silva strides forward and defends it to the off side.
Mathews gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side for one.

Spin and bounce into the batsman, exploding from the surface, de Silva is hurried up in defense and is hit on the body. The ball pops out and the batsman has no idea where the ball is. It lands in front of him eventually as the short leg fielder gets forward to collect it.
Charges down the track and pushes it down to long on for one.
Tossed up ball on middle, helped off the pads to backward square leg.
Flighted ball on off, Mathews defends it back to the bowler.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Silva goes back and defends it off his back foot.
A well directed yorker, tailing in at the stumps. Silva is alert to it and digs it out well.

Fullish delivery around off, Mathews pushes it to the off side and the batsmen scamper for a quick single. The throw was at the non striker's end and it struck the foot of Mathews. They decided not to go for an extra run!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A little fuller, angling in. Mathews strides forward to negotiate the swing and defends it to the off side.
Length delivery around off, angling in. Mathews goes back and blocks it into the ground.

Appeal for a catch! Full length ball sliding down the leg side, de Silva tries to flick but misses. There is some noise as it goes past the batsman and they appeal. Nothing from the umpire and Australia decide not to take the referral. Maybe, clipping the pads.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone this time by de Silva.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot by de Silva.
FOUR! Full in length and outside off, de Silva gets on the front foot and drives it crisply through the gap at covers for a boundary.
A low full toss on middle, Mathews works it through mid-wicket for three runs.
Angles across a full ball around off, Mathews quietly pushes it through point for a couple of runs. 200 up for Sri Lanka!
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Dhananjaya de Silva is the new batsman.
OUT! Fullish delivery on middle, tailing in. Chandimal strides forward and looks to work it through the leg side but hits it directly to Usman Khwaja at short mid-wicket who takes an easy catch!
FOUR LEG BYES.  A length delivery on middle, tailing in, strikes Chandimal on the thigh pad and it runs down to fine leg for a boundary.
Short delivery on middle, banged in! Mathews rocks back and pulls it from outside off for a single.
Full toss on leg stump, Mathews flicks it well through mid-wicket for another couple!
A tad short on leg stump, Mathews rolls his arms and guides it through square leg for a couple.
Pitches it full and on off, Chandimal gets on the front foot and pushes it to mid off.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, straightening a bit, Chandimal gets across the stumps and shoulders arms.
Bouncer on this occasion, Chandimal ducks. Once again Starc sledges the Sri Lankan vice-captain.
A high full toss, bowled at a good pace, Chandimal does well to keep it out safely. Starc has a few words to share with Chandimal, definitely not apologizing.
On a length around off, angling in, Chandimal goes on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Full in length and angling into the batsman, Chandimal covers the line and defends it with a vertical bat.
Mathews defends it off the backfoot.

Back of a length delivery outside off. Chandimal guides it through the slip cordon and the ball rolls towards the third man boundary. Voges puts in a good effort and passes the ball to Marsh. The batsmen come back for the third run!
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A fullish delivery, angling in sharply. Mathews works it through square leg for a single. There is reverse swing in the air!
Length delivery around middle and leg. Mathews goes back and defends it.
Shout for an lbw! Starc angles in a full ball around middle and leg, Chandimal fails to keep it out and is struck on the pads. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Maybe, missing leg.
Length ball on off, Chandimal defends it from the crease.

Starc is in superb rhythm at the moment. Changes his angle for the new batsman and comes in from round the wicket. He lets out a full ball outside off and gets it to reverse away a bit, Chandimal with unsure footwork pushes at it and misses. Bowling of the highest quality by Starc!
Dinesh Chandimal joins his skipper in the middle.

OUT! Starc strikes to get his 100th Test wicket! Superb delivery, on back of a length around middle and off, nipping away a shade, Mendis is caught on the back foot, gets squared up a bit as he has a tame push inside the line. Gets a faint nick and Nevill grabs the ball by getting low. Starc straightaway puts in an appeal, the keeper is late in joining him and to the delight of the Aussies, the finger goes up. Brilliant knock from Mendis comes to an end, he is unfortunate not to score another century.
Full and angling away from the batsman, an easy leave for Mendis.
Fuller in length and around off, Mendis defends it by getting on the front foot.
Outside off, Mathews tries to defend it but misses the ball.
Around off, Mendis taps it towards third man for a single.
Bouncer! Mendis does well to evade it.
Kusal Mendis seems to have hurt his fingers a ball prior to the last delivery. The physio is out addressing the issue. Slight hold up in play.
FOUR! Fullish delivery around off, Mendis punches that off the front foot through mid-wicket for a classy boundary! He is in great form!
Short delivery around middle, draws Mendis into an uncomfortable position and strikes him high on the gloves. Good delivery!
A length delivery outside off, angling in. Mendis comes on the front foot, covers the line well and blocks it into the ground.
Identical to the last delivery and once again Mathews is solid in his front foot defense.
Fuller and on off, a pacey delivery, Mathews meets it with a dead bat and keeps it out on the off side.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Difficult angle to negotiate for Mendis. Lands it around off and gets it to straighten from there, Kusal pushes at it and misses.
Fullish and on off, Mendis gets forward, opens the face of the bat and pushes it through covers for a couple of runs.
Starc continues from round the wicket and spears in a very full ball on middle, Mathews digs it out on the leg side. It's in the gap and they cross for a run.
Drinks break.
Fuller length delivery around off, Mendis goes forward and pushes it to the covers.
Around off, Mendis defends it from within the crease.

It's missing leg! Fullish delivery around off, angles in sharply and strikes Mendis on the pads. He is adjuged LBW by the umpire. But Mendis takes a review and the Hawk Eye shows the ball is just going down the leg side. Mendis survives!
Mendis is adjudged lbw. He is reviewing it. Looks close.
A similar delivery, angling in more sharply this time. Mendis lets it go.
A back of a length delivery, angling in. Mendis watches it carefully and lets it go.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
Josh Hazlewood is back on.

Loose shot! Fuller in length and angling into the batsman, Mendis tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It pops out of the leading edge and loops over the bowler's head. The ball lands safely to the left of the mid on fielder and they take a single.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Fullish in length and outside off, Mendis stretches forward and caresses it through covers for a lovely boundary.
On a length and around off, Mendis taps it down towards gully.
Angles in a length ball on off, Mendis pushes it with the outer half of the bat to gully.
A touch short in length and around leg, Mendis glances it to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Full length ball angling into the batsman, Mendis gets behind the line and blocks.
Flatter outside off, Mendis pushes it through covers for a single.
Around off, Mendis punches it to the covers off his back foot.
50-run stand between Mathews and Mendis, off just 56 balls. Mathews has contributed 34 runs in it. A quickfire knock by the Sri Lankan skipper.
Played to the point region by Mathews for a single.
SIX! Tossed up outside off, Mathews dances down the wicket and strikes a meaty blow over long off! That's a wonderful shot!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full toss on middle, the batsman fails to capitalize on it and finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Starc bangs in a short ball around middle, well-directed, Mendis sits under it. Excellent over by Starc!
Beaten again! Terrific bowling by Starc, landing on a length around off and getting it to straighten a touch, Mendis tentatively pushes inside the line and misses.

FOUR LEG BYES! Wrong line by Starc, sliding down the leg side, Mendis fails to work it on the leg side and it kisses his thigh pad before flying behind. Nevill dives to his left but fails to collect it. The ball brushes his gloves and races away to the fine leg fence.
Misses the yorker this time and lets out a full toss outside off, Mendis goes for a full-blooded cover drive but once again is beaten for pace.
Angles in a full ball on off, Mendis gets forward and defends it solidly to the off side.

Peach of a delivery, a fine yorker around off, shaping away a touch, Mendis fails to dig it out and nearly edges it behind. The bowler appeals for a catch but the umpire shakes his head. Beaten for pace, Kusal!
Mitchell Starc is brought back into the attack. Change of ends for him and now he will be bowling into the breeze.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Around middle and leg, Mendis strides forward and pushes it down to mid off for a single.
Defended off the front foot by Mendis presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated around off, Mendis strides forward and defends it.
Flatter and shorter around off, left alone by the batsman.
Tossed up outside off, Mendis hits it aerially over covers for a couple. The timing was not quite there on the shot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Too full in length and around middle, Mathews comes down the track and pushes it back. Lyon does well to stop with his right hand.
Flatter and shorter on off, hit through the gap at covers for a couple of runs.
Once again Mendis goes down to emulate the last shot but this time it takes the top edge. The ball falls safely in the deep and the fielder at square leg does the fielding. They take a single.
FOUR! Fine shot! A loopy off spinner on off, Mendis goes down on one knee and sweeps it sweetly through square leg for a boundary.
Tossed up ball on off, Mendis gets on the front foot and defends it to short leg.
SIX! Around leg stump, Mathews dances down the track and lifts it handsomely over wide long on for a great six!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by Mathews presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed around middle and leg, Mathews lunges forward and blocks it into the ground.
Flatter around off, Mathews defends it off his front foot.
Floated around off, Mathews pushes it to covers.
Jon Holland replaces Starc in the attack.
Gets on the front foot and drives it back to the bowler.

Uppish and just over the infield. Mathews once again plays the reverse sweep but fails to control it. The ball catches the top edge and balloons over cover point. Starc gives the chase and pulls it back just before the ropes. They take three runs.
Flighted ball around leg, Mathews dances down the track and brings his bat and pad together in defense.
Tossed up ball on middle, Mathews goes back and works it off his pads. Finds short fine leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted ball on leg, nudged through backward square leg for a single.
Starc runs in from round the wicket and angles in a full ball on off, Mathews pushes it off the outside part of the bat to point.
Short delivery going down the leg side, Neville dives athletically to the left and makes a fine save!
Length delivery wide outside off, Mathews flirts with it and gets away with it.
Full on middle, Mathews pushes it back to Starc.
Fuller outside off, Mathews guides it to the point region.
A back of a length delivery around off, Mathews gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it solidly.
A touch short and on off, Mendis cuts it from the back foot to point.
Advances down the track to a full ball and pushes it to mid off. The fielder dives to stop the ball and they cross in the meantime for a run.
FOUR! Shot! Mathews is taking on Lyon here. A flighted ball around leg, Mathews brings out the reverse sweep and nails it past point for a boundary.
Tossed up ball on off, Mendis goes down on one knee and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Spinning down the leg side, Mendis pads it away.
Full flighted ball on middle and leg, Mendis gets forward and defends it on the leg side.
Short delivery around leg stump, zips off the pitch. Mathew ducks under it and the keeper has to jump to make a save!
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Mathew goes back and defends it off his back foot.
Down the leg side, Mathews leaves it alone.
FOUR! Fuller outside off, Mathew steers it past the slip region for a well worked boundary!
A full length delivery around off, Mendis guides it through covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery around off, seams away a bit. Mendis plays at it but misses. Good stuff from Starc!
Flatter and around off, Mathews gets behind the line and blocks it with a straight bat.
SIX! Mathews making his intentions clear. Advances down to the pitch of the ball and launches it over long on for a maximum. He is not going to allow Lyon settle down.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Flighted on middle, Mathews sweeps it down through square leg for one.
Skipper Angelo Mathews is in next.

OUT! The partnership of 108 Tossed up ball around off, drifting in and turning away viciously with some extra bounce. Perera stays back to play inside the line and ends up edging it behind at first slip. Smith grabs it comfortably and Perera misses out on his fifty. Lovely delivery by Lyon!
Defended off the backfoot by the batsman.

Huge shout for an lbw! Starc angles in a full ball around off, Perera gets forward in defense but seems to have missed it. He is rapped on the pads, Starc roars in appeal but the umpire turns it down. Steven Smith gestures that it might be hitting the batsman outside the line of the off stump and hence they don't go for the review. The replays show that there was an inside edge. In fact, if we zoom in more, it could have been pad first. Anyway, no referral taken, so no need to waste time on this. Just for the record, the impact was within the line of the stumps.
Hurls in a very full ball, around leg at 146 kph, Mendis helps it off his pads to mid-wicket and takes a single.
FOUR! Superbly played! Back of a length delivery angling away from the batsman, Mendis stands tall inside the crease, rides the bounce and guides it wide of gully and backward point for a boundary.
Bouncer around off, 142 kph, an easy duck for Mendis.
Keeps it full and close to the off stump line, Mendis gets behind the line and defends it solidly to the off side.
Fuller in length and around leg, Mendis flicks it off his pads towards mid-wicket.
Mitchell Starc to steam in from the other end.
Too full in length and around leg, Perera brings down a straight bat and pushes it to mid on.
Flighted and on middle, Perera kneels down and sweeps it to fine leg for a couple of runs. Good sliding stop in the deep by Starc.
Tossed up ball on off, drifting in, Perera comes down the track and pushes it towards short cover.
Short again and outside off, Perera slaps it through the line but finds point.
Slightly short and on off, Perera keeps it out off the back foot to the off side.
Starts with a tossed up ball around middle, Perera goes back inside the crease and defends it down.
We're back for the afternoon session. The men concerned are out in the middle. It will be Nathan Lyon to begin proceedings. All set, here we go again.
...DAY 1, SESSION 2...

Perera and Mendis have been solid and are timing the ball well. Mendis is in outstanding form and he is stamping his authority on the Aussie bowlers yet again. Australia need to find a way to break this threatening partnership. It has been a sporting two hours of cricket and Sri Lanka are well poised at the moment. Do join us in a while for the post lunch session.

That has been quite an interesting first session of the match. Starc was sharp and impressive and bowled with good intensity, troubling the Sri Lankan top order and grabbed a couple of wickets. The pitch is taking a lot of turn and Lyon and Holland bowled with discipline but Perera and Mendis tackled them well and didn't let them settle down.
Another watchful front foot defense by Mendis to end the over. LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Tossed up ball on off, Mendis gets on the front foot and defends it watchfully.
Around off, a loopy ball, Mendis defends it from the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
100-run stand comes up!
Jumps out of the crease and pushes it through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Through the legs of leg gully! Perera advances down the track and yorks himself. He tries to dig it out but it goes off the inside part of the bat and races for a boundary.
This will be the last over before lunch.
Tossed up ball on middle, Mendis stays back and turns it past short leg.
Uppish but safe! Flighted ball on off, Perera fails to control his drive and it goes aerially and just wide of short extra cover. They cross for a run.
Flatter and shorter on off, Perera goes back to cut but misses.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy full ball on off, Perera comes forward and offers a straight bat in defense.
Tossed up ball on off, shorter in length, Perera goes back with the cut shot but due to some extra bounce he ends up playing it in the air. Luckily for him, it doesn't carry to point.
Nathan Lyon is brought back into the attack.
Slower through the air and landing full around leg, Mendis lunges in defense.
Mendis has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up ball on middle, driven back to the bowler with a straight bat.
Full and around the pads, it's eased through the gap at mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
2nd Test fifty for Kusal Mendis.

A touch short and around off, Mendis goes back immediately and cuts it past point for a couple of runs. Another fab knock by Mendis to back up his elegant century at Pallekele. Also 100 comes up for Sri Lanka!
Loopy full ball on off, Mendis lunges and presents a straight bat in defense.
Perera lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Short delivery on middle and leg, Mendis plays a pull shot and the batsmen run for a single.
FOUR! A widish half volley, Mendis leans into the drive and crunches it elegantly through covers for a beautiful boundary!
"My god I wouldn't like to be chasing anymore than 140 on this pitch in Galle... Massive Bunson burner !" tweets the former Australian player Dean Jones.
Back of a length delivery around off, Mendis drives it to the cover region.
Fuller on off and middle, Mendis strides forward and defends it solidly.
Short delivery outside off, Perera square cuts it effortlessly for a single.
Advances down the track to a full ball and drives it to long on for a run.
Flighted around leg, swept straight to leg gully who failed to stop it this time and allowed it through his legs. A couple of runs taken.
Tossed up ball on leg, turned off the pads towards leg gully who stopped the ball.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Great delivery, loopy full around off, Mendis tries to sweep but it spins away to beat him completely. They appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Mendis works it behind square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Perera goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Fuller on middle, Perera drills it wide of mid on off his front foot and the ball races to the boundary. That was a superb shot!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length ball on off, Perera stays back and punches it back to the bowler.
Good flight and a bit of away turn, Mendis lunges and defends it with an angled bat to point. End of an eventful over.
Bowls it with a round-arm action, full and around middle, spinning away a bit, Mendis gets on the front foot in defense.
Knocks a full ball down through mid on for a run.
Spin and bounce into the batsman, Perera fails to defend and is hit on the pads. It pops out, the short leg fielder takes the catch, they appeal but once again the umpire is not interested.
Flighted full ball on off, Mendis walks forward a bit and defends it closer to his pads. Nevill appeals but nothing from the bowler and the umpire.

GREAT EFFORT FROM LYON! Technically a dropped catch but it will be very harsh on the fielder who has eventually saved four runs for his team. Floated on middle, Perera dances down the track and heaves it aerially towards the mid-wicket fence. Lyon in the deep moves briskly to his right and grabs the ball one-handed. He knew that the momentum would take him past the boundary so he flicks the ball inside the boundary just before he fell near the boundary covers. That was an unbelievable effort! They take a couple of runs.
Lands it full and outside off, it's quietly pushed off the front foot to covers. A maiden!
Fullish and on off, stump to stump line by Hazlewood, Mendis gets behind the line and offers the full face of the bat in defense.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Keeps his line outside off and serves it on a length, Mendis once again chooses to ignore it.
Pitches it full and around off, nipping in a bit, Perera gets on the front foot and drives it towards mid off.
Full in length and in the zone outside off, a hint of inward shape there, Mendis shoulders arms after covering the line.
Josh Hazlewood is back for another spell.
Fuller on middle and leg, played to the mid-wicket region by Mendis for a single.
A similar delivery on middle, Mendis goes down on one knee and tries the sweep shot but the ball takes extra bounce and hits him on the right shoulder.
FOUR! Tossed up on leg stump, Mendis gets down on his knees and sweeps it well behind square leg for a well crafted boundary!
Mendis has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side for a single.
Walks down the track to take it on the full and clips it through mid-wicket for three runs.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Short and on off, spinning away, Perera goes back and cuts it in the air. Luckily for him it doesn't carry to cover-point.
Advances down the track with a straight bat and defends it back to the bowler.
Nice shot! Mendis goes down on one knee, fetches a full ball from outside off and sweeps it with the spin to fine leg for a single.
Flighted full ball on middle, Perera jumps out of the crease and drives it to long off for a run.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR BYES! Floated delivery around leg, turns away significantly, the batsman leaves it alone, the keeper gets a little blind sighted and fails to collect the ball. It travels to the boundary.
On off and middle, Mendis strides forward and drives it well through covers for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Mendis drives it to covers.
The batsman goes for the sweep but fails to connect it.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Mendis draws forward and defends it solidly.
Debutant Jon Holland is introduced into the attack. He is a left-arm orthodox bowler. A slip and short leg in place for Mendis.
Full and on off, Perera draws forward and defends it solidly.
Loopy full ball on off, drifting in and spinning away, Perera lunges to defend but gets a soft outside edge wide of first slip.
Flatter and shorter on off, Perera cuts it to point and Mitchell Marsh quickly moves to his left to stop the ball. No run.
Straightaway uses his feet to smother the spin and defends it down safely.
Spin and bounce away from the batsman, Perera pushes at it and misses.
Short and wide outside off, Perera goes back and cuts it towards backward point. Mitchell Marsh dives to his right to take the pace off the ball and they take a couple of runs.
Mendis rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball.
Good length ball around off, Mendis drives it to mid off.
50-run stand between Perera and Mendis.
FOUR! Length delivery around off and middle, Mendis spicks it off his pads and flicks it beautifully over mid-wicket for a boundary! Pure class from Mendis.
A back of a length delivery around off, Mendis defends it off his back foot.
Fuller and outside off, Mendis strides forward and drives it to covers.
A length delivery outside off, Mendis goes back and defends it towards covers.
Short and pulled down the leg side for a single.
Slower through the air around middle, Mendis defends it down to short leg.
SIX! Excellent shot! A tossed up ball around middle and off, Mendis gets on the front foot with a straight bat and lofts it nonchalantly over the mid off region for a clean maximum.
Quicker on off, Mendis defends it off his back foot.
Tossed up ball on off, Perera taps it down softly in the gap at covers for a run.
Short in length and outside off, Mendis goes back and cuts it through point for three runs.
FOUR! Fuller and outside off, Perera strides forward confidently and cover drives it classically for a beautiful boundary!
Length delivery around middle, Mendis works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Mendis lets that one go through to the keeper.
Length delivery around off, seams away. Draws Mendis to play at that one who tries to defend it but the ball is too good for him! It beats him completely.
A tad short around middle, Mendis has defended that off his back foot.
A back of a length delivery around off, Perera goes back and punches it through mid-wicket for a single.
DRINKS BREAK.

SIX! Fine shot! He played the similar shot to reach his century at Pallekele. Flighted ball on off, Mendis goes down on one knee and slogs it handsomely over mid-wicket for a biggie. There was a fielder in the deep but he was a mere spectator.
Walks down the track to a full ball and strokes it through mid off for a run.
A touch flatter and shorter on off, Perera goes back and punches it to the off side.
This time Perera dances down the track to a full ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Full floated ball on off, Perera gets forward and defends it watchfully.
Tossed up ball on middle, pushed back to the left of the bowler who stopped it in his followthrough.
Fuller outside off, driven back straight towards Marsh who does well to stop it.
FOUR! Over-pitched delivery on middle and leg, Mendis flicks it through mid-wicket for a wonderful boundary! That was pleasing to watch!
The batsman strides forward and blocks it into the ground.
Fuller and outside off, Mendis leaves it this time and lets it go.
Shorter and outside off, Mendis has a wild slash at it and gets beaten completely. That was a poor shot!
A peach of a delivery to begin with. Length delivery outside off, seams in a little. Mendis plays at it but misses it.
Mitchell Marsh comes into the attack!
A touch shortish and around off, Perera goes back and cuts it through point. It's chased down in the deep and they take a couple of runs.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Loopy full ball around leg, Perera looks to play on the leg side but it comes off the outer half of the bat and rolls back to the bowler.
Perera has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Advances down the track for a big shot but it spins in to take the inside part of the bat. It rolls through square leg and they cross for one run.
Walks forward to a full ball and drives it all along the ground through mid off for a run.
FOUR! Fuller and outside off, Mendis lunges forward and times his drive to perfection through covers for a superb boundary!
Bouncer! Very short though. Mendis ducks under it comfortably!
Length delivery around off, the batsman pokes at it but fails to connect.
A full toss outside off. Mendis has a go at it but the ball takes the outside edge of his bat and goes on one bounce to second slip. Steven Smith makes a good stop!
Full and outside off, driven from the crease to the off side, not in the gap though as the extra cover fielder made a partial stop. They cross for a run now.
Full and angled into the batsman, Perera defends it solidly from the back foot.
Mendis has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Strides forward and drives it to long off for a run.
Gets forward and drives it to covers. Confusion over a single but they decide against it.
A little bit of away spin on this occasion, Perera defends it off the outside half of the bat to the off side.
Tossed up ball on off again, Perera is forward in defense.
Flighted full ball on off, Perera gets on the front foot and pushes it back to the bowler.
Spin introduced very early by Australia. Nathan Lyon to have a bowl!
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
That was a peach of a delivery from Starc! Length ball angled away from around off, zips off the pitch. Mendis pokes at it and misses it completely!
Fuller on middle and leg, Mendis plays it through mid-wicket.
Outside off, Mendis leaves it alone.

FOUR! Short delivery on middle and leg, Mendis plays it awkwardly from the crease and gloves it down the leg side for a boundary! The keeper dives to his left but the ball goes past him from a very close range. Mendis is finally off the mark rather unconvincingly!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! That's a cracking shot! Full on leg stump, Perera flicks it handsomely off his pads and the ball races to the mid-wicket boundary in no time!
Outside off, Perera watches it carefully and lets it go.
Length delivery, angling away. Perera throws a kitchen sink at it  but misses it completely. That was a poor attempted shot!
A very short delivery on middle, zips off the pitch and flies to the wicketkeeper.
Back of a length delivery around off, Perera defends it off his back foot.
Length delivery around off, Perera walks down a bit and defends it towards the covers.

Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.

Much better this time by Perera. Movement away from the right-hander, sharp pace too, 149 kph, Mendis watchfully lets it through to the keeper.

Nearly edges it. Starc bowls it full and wide outside off, 144 kph, Mendis goes chasing as he tries to play a booming drive but fails to connect. Almost a carbon copy of Silva's dismissal, only difference is that Mendis doesn't nick it.

Back of a length delivery outside off, Mendis lets it go.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length delivery around off, Mendis strides forward and pushes it confidently to the covers.
Length delivery around off, Mendis drives it to mid on.

Good length ball on off, Mendis defends it from the crease.
Hero of the last Test, Kusal Mendis walks in next at number 4.

OUT! Poor, poor shot from Kaushal Silva and he pays a big price for it. Smart bowling by Starc, he follows up the short ball with a tempting full ball outside off, 148 kph, Silva is lured into the drive away from his body and nicks it behind. Nevill makes no mistake and Sri Lanka have now lost both their openers to a rash shot.

FOUR! Cracking shot! Pacey short ball around middle, 149 kph, Silva meets fire with fire and pulls it stylishly through square leg for a boundary. Hazlewood at fine leg fails to pick it up and was late in reacting.
Good length ball around off, once again bowled with a speedy pace, 146 kph, Silva defends it off his back foot.
Too full in length around off, 146 kph, Silva digs it out to the off side.
Outside off, Perera leaves it alone.
Short delivery outside off, Perera does well to leave that one.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
FOUR! That's a beautiful shot! Full length delivery around off, Perera lunges forward and cover drives it beautifully for an exquisite boundary! That was a treat to watch!
Around off, driven towards the mid off region by Perera.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad.

STAT ALERT - Today is the second time Sri Lanka have lost a wicket off the first ball of a Test match, interestingly both against Australia and that too at Galle. Sanath Jayasuriya in 1999 was the other occasion.
Around off, defended off the front foot by Silva presenting the full face of the bat.
Around off, played to the point region by the batsman.
Around off, seaming away a bit. Silva gets stuck on the crease and plays at the ball half-heartedly. The ball takes the outside edge and falls short of second slip.
The batsman gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it into the ground.
Silva defends it solidly off his back foot.
Short delivery wide outside off, The batsman watches it fly to the wicket keeper.
Around off, Silva pushes it to covers off his front foot. The batsmen scamper for a single.
Almost a carbon copy of the previous delivery.
A back of a length delivery outside off, Silva watches it carefully and lets it go.
Full length delivery outside off, Silva inside edges it and the ball hits him on the pads.
The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards the slip region.
A length delivery around off, pitched on the corridor of uncertainity. Draws Silva into an uncomfortable position and takes the outside edge of his bat which falls short of second slip.
Josh Hazlewood to share the new cherry from the other end.
Pitches it full and outside off, Perera squeezes it out and it goes on one bounce to Lyon at point. End of a terrific first over by Mitch!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Sharp delivery, full and on off, 144 kph, Perera covers the line and defends it.
Full toss down the leg side, Starc probably loses his grip there, Perera tries to flick but misses.
Back of a length delivery around off, Perera pokes at it and misses it completely. That was a peach of a delivery! Great bowling from Starc!
Interesting move. Kusal Perera is send in at number 3.

OUT! Wicket on the first ball for Australia! It's a full length delivery on middle and leg, Karunaratne flicks it straight to mid-wicket, it is uppish and Burns stationed there takes an easy catch! A poor shot and he pays the price for it!
Right then, it's time to get underway. The Sri Lankan openers Dimuth Karunaratne and Kaushal Silva are out in the centre. It will be Mitchell Starc to steam in first up. Here we go...

Steven Smith says that they have to bowl well first up. He feels there will be some moisture early on and there will be a bit of tackiness as well which will help the spinners. He confirms that Jon Holland is making his debut, replacing the injured Stephen O'Keefe. Also emphasizes that they have to go big in the first innings and bowl out Sri Lanka cheaply.

Angelo Mathews smiles and says that they will like to bat first. He opines the wicket looks dry and they have to bat well to put runs on the board. He informs about the one change, Nuwan Pradeep is out injured and is replaced by debutant Vishwa Fernando. Also adds that they have to do the basics right and the results will take care of itself.
SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT!

A warm welcome to one and all. The second Test at Galle is about to begin and we are in for five days of testing and gritty cricket. Australia would take some heart and confidence from the fact that out of the 3 Test matches they have played at Galle, they haven't lost a single one. They have won two Test matches and have drawn one. Stay tuned for more updates...

Herath and Sandakan showed great character in the fourth innings and weaved their magic on the Aussie batsmen. Australia's weakness to handle quality spin was exposed once again and they got bundled out for 161. If they are to garner any chances of coming back in the second Test at Galle, they have to play out of their skins and humble the Sri Lankan Lions at their own den.

Sri Lanka will be riding high on confidence after their convincing win over Australia in the first Test match. From being bundled out for a paltry 117 in the first innings to registering a Test victory by 106 runs speaks for itself. Kusal Mendis' exceptional innings of 176 in the third innings stretched Sri Lanka's lead to a match winning 267 runs and from that stage it was always an uphill task for the Australian batsmen to chase the target.
